primitives.name: Site Selection Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: Three to choose from, and The Table as its own package.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N_{sites}': 'dimensionless, number of selectable websites', 'C_{site}': '$, cost per site'}
primitives.assumptions: Each site is functionally equivalent except for design aesthetic; user preference determines final selection.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When N_{sites} < 1 or all sites fail to render correctly.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a multi-armed bandit problem where each site represents an arm with stochastic reward (booking rate).
layer2.telemetry: User click-through rate on site previews and subsequent booking conversion.

primitives.name: Booking Workflow System
primitives.verbatim_quote: 3 Booked Every quote request on your phone in seconds, logged so none goes unanswered.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{response}': 's, average time to respond to quote request', 'Q_{logged}': 'dimensionless, total logged quote requests', 'U_{agent}': 'dimensionless, user agent identifier'}
primitives.assumptions: All quote requests are processed within T_{response}; logging ensures no request is lost.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_{response} > threshold or Q_{logged} drops below minimum viable volume.

layer2.mapping: Derived from a kernel of event-driven messaging logic that triggers upon quote receipt.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of quote requests responded to within 10 seconds and logged status.

primitives.name: Reputation Integration Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: Every page uses your real prices, your own photos and your reviews from The Knot and WeddingWire.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_{review}': 'rating, average score from external platforms', 'P_{price}': '$, displayed price point', 'I_{image}': 'dimensionless, image quality index'}
primitives.assumptions: Reviews and pricing are consistent across platforms; images reflect actual service quality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R_{review} < 4.0 or P_{price} mismatches market expectation.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a reputational signal fusion framework combining third-party ratings and internal metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Average review rating from Knot/WeddingWire and percentage of price consistency checks passed.

The system's robustness depends on maintaining alignment between these layers through continuous feedback mechanisms.
